spans.s: + दृष्टि अ- + दृष्टि, f. a look of displeasure.

+ पुरुष अ-दृष्ट- + पुरुष (vb. दृश्), adj. (viz. संधि), a kind of alliance where one party alone settles for the other, on the condition that the enemy has to disburse the expenses of the expedition, Hit. iv. d. 117.
